source.title: Fine Structures of Berry Curvature and Unquantized Valley Chern Numbers in Valley Photonic Crystals
source.paper_valley_label: K-HBZ centered at K; the panel dashed triangle is the half-Brillouin-zone guide
source.k_location_in_panel: K is at the center of the dashed half-Brillouin-zone triangle
source.color_sign_convention: Use only the paper colorbar labeled normalized Berry curvature Omega/a^2; no raster digitization, color-to-number conversion, or pixel fitting is permitted

source_supported_qualitative_descriptors.band1: Omega_1 is extremely small; the paper reports C_v^1=-0.03
source_supported_qualitative_descriptors.band2: The distribution contains petal and island regions with opposite Berry-curvature signs
source_supported_qualitative_descriptors.band3: The distribution contains petal and island regions with opposite Berry-curvature signs
source_supported_qualitative_descriptors.band23: Bands 2 and 3 dominate the chirality near f_r=0.4; the paper reports C_v^2=0.94 and C_v^3=-0.89, but these values are not recomputed or used as acceptance thresholds
source_supported_qualitative_descriptors.fr0_to_fr04: The source describes band-1 suppression, band-2 sign change, and enhanced band-2/band-3 contributions as f_r increases to 0.4
